threshold_proximity_10k.aml_meaning: Detects transactions intentionally broken to avoid $10,000 reporting threshold
threshold_proximity_10k.temporal_safety: Computed from current transaction amount only
threshold_proximity_10k.observability: Makes structuring observable by detecting near-threshold patterns

threshold_proximity_5k.aml_meaning: Detects transactions intentionally broken to avoid lower reporting thresholds
threshold_proximity_5k.temporal_safety: Computed from current transaction amount only
threshold_proximity_5k.observability: Makes structuring observable by detecting near-threshold patterns

near_threshold_count_7d.definition: Count of transactions in last 7 days with amount in [8000, 12000]
near_threshold_count_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
near_threshold_count_7d.observability: Makes structuring observable by detecting clustering near threshold

near_threshold_ratio_7d.definition: Ratio of near-threshold transactions to total transactions in last 7 days
near_threshold_ratio_7d.aml_meaning: Detects high proportion of near-threshold activity
near_threshold_ratio_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
near_threshold_ratio_7d.observability: Makes structuring observable by detecting clustering near threshold

amount_clustering_score.definition: Standard deviation of transaction amounts in last 7 days
amount_clustering_score.aml_meaning: Low variance indicates intentional amount clustering (structuring)
amount_clustering_score.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
amount_clustering_score.observability: Makes structuring observable by detecting amount clustering

counterparty_diversity_7d.definition: Number of unique receiver accounts in last 7 days
counterparty_diversity_7d.aml_meaning: High diversity indicates layering (funds moving through many accounts)
counterparty_diversity_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
counterparty_diversity_7d.observability: Makes layering observable by detecting counterparty diversity

counterparty_diversity_30d.definition: Number of unique receiver accounts in last 30 days
counterparty_diversity_30d.aml_meaning: High diversity indicates layering (funds moving through many accounts)
counterparty_diversity_30d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 30 days only)
counterparty_diversity_30d.observability: Makes layering observable by detecting counterparty diversity

pass_through_ratio_7d.definition: Ratio of outbound transfers to total transactions in last 7 days
pass_through_ratio_7d.aml_meaning: High pass-through ratio indicates layering (funds moving through account)
pass_through_ratio_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
pass_through_ratio_7d.observability: Makes layering observable by detecting pass-through behavior

rapid_counterparty_switch_count.definition: Number of times receiver account changes in last 7 days
rapid_counterparty_switch_count.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
rapid_counterparty_switch_count.observability: Makes layering observable by detecting rapid counterparty changes

single_counterparty_dominance_7d.definition: Maximum percentage of transactions to single receiver in last 7 days
single_counterparty_dominance_7d.aml_meaning: Low dominance indicates layering (funds distributed across many)
single_counterparty_dominance_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
single_counterparty_dominance_7d.observability: Makes layering observable by detecting lack of counterparty concentration

inbound_aggregation_7d.definition: Ratio of deposits to total transactions in last 7 days
inbound_aggregation_7d.aml_meaning: High inbound ratio indicates funnel (funds from many sources)
inbound_aggregation_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
inbound_aggregation_7d.observability: Makes funnel observable by detecting inbound aggregation

outbound_diversification_7d.definition: Ratio of transfers to total transactions in last 7 days
outbound_diversification_7d.aml_meaning: High outbound ratio indicates funnel (funds distributed to many)
outbound_diversification_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
outbound_diversification_7d.observability: Makes funnel observable by detecting outbound diversification

many_to_one_ratio_7d.definition: Ratio of unique senders to unique receivers in last 7 days (network perspective)
many_to_one_ratio_7d.aml_meaning: Low ratio indicates funnel (many senders to few receivers)
many_to_one_ratio_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
many_to_one_ratio_7d.observability: Makes funnel observable by detecting many-to-one patterns

concentration_index_7d.definition: Herfindahl index of receiver concentration in last 7 days
concentration_index_7d.aml_meaning: High concentration indicates funnel (funds concentrated to few receivers)
concentration_index_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
concentration_index_7d.observability: Makes funnel observable by detecting receiver concentration

inbound_to_outbound_time_avg_7d.definition: Average time between deposit and subsequent transfer in last 7 days
inbound_to_outbound_time_avg_7d.aml_meaning: Short average time indicates rapid movement (funds pass through quickly)
inbound_to_outbound_time_avg_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
inbound_to_outbound_time_avg_7d.observability: Makes rapid movement observable by detecting quick pass-through

same_day_pass_through_count_7d.definition: Count of deposit-transfer pairs occurring on same day in last 7 days
same_day_pass_through_count_7d.aml_meaning: High count indicates rapid movement (funds pass through same day)
same_day_pass_through_count_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
same_day_pass_through_count_7d.observability: Makes rapid movement observable by detecting same-day pass-through

funds_through_ratio_7d.definition: Ratio of outbound amount to inbound amount in last 7 days
funds_through_ratio_7d.aml_meaning: High ratio indicates rapid movement (most inbound funds passed through)
funds_through_ratio_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
funds_through_ratio_7d.observability: Makes rapid movement observable by detecting funds pass-through

velocity_score_7d.definition: Average number of transactions per day in last 7 days
velocity_score_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 7 days only)
velocity_score_7d.observability: Makes rapid movement observable by detecting high transaction velocity

amount_deviation_from_baseline_30d.definition: Z-score of current amount relative to 30-day historical mean
amount_deviation_from_baseline_30d.aml_meaning: High deviation indicates sudden change in amount behavior
amount_deviation_from_baseline_30d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 30 days only)
amount_deviation_from_baseline_30d.observability: Makes behavioral change observable by detecting amount deviation

frequency_deviation_from_baseline_30d.definition: Z-score of current transaction count relative to 30-day historical mean
frequency_deviation_from_baseline_30d.aml_meaning: High deviation indicates sudden change in frequency behavior
frequency_deviation_from_baseline_30d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 30 days only)
frequency_deviation_from_baseline_30d.observability: Makes behavioral change observable by detecting frequency deviation

counterparty_change_score_7d.definition: Jaccard similarity between current 7-day and previous 7-day receiver sets
counterparty_change_score_7d.aml_meaning: Low similarity indicates sudden change in counterparty behavior
counterparty_change_score_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 14 days: current 7d vs previous 7d)
counterparty_change_score_7d.observability: Makes behavioral change observable by detecting counterparty change

rolling_behavioral_change_7d.definition: Standard deviation of amounts in last 7 days divided by standard deviation in previous 7 days
rolling_behavioral_change_7d.aml_meaning: High ratio indicates sudden change in amount variability
rolling_behavioral_change_7d.temporal_safety: Computed from historical transactions (last 14 days: current 7d vs previous 7d)
rolling_behavioral_change_7d.observability: Makes behavioral change observable by detecting variability change

concurrent_suspicious_indicators.definition: Count of suspicious behavioral indicators present simultaneously
concurrent_suspicious_indicators.aml_meaning: High count indicates multiple AML typologies (severe scenario)
concurrent_suspicious_indicators.temporal_safety: Computed from current transaction features only
concurrent_suspicious_indicators.observability: Makes severe scenarios observable by aggregating suspicious indicators

typology_aggregation_score.definition: Combined score based on structuring + layering + funnel + rapid_movement indicators
typology_aggregation_score.aml_meaning: High score indicates multiple AML typologies (severe scenario)
typology_aggregation_score.temporal_safety: Computed from current transaction features only
typology_aggregation_score.observability: Makes severe scenarios observable by aggregating typology indicators

severity_index.definition: Weighted sum of suspicious indicators based on severity weights
severity_index.aml_meaning: High index indicates severe scenario (multiple typologies)
severity_index.temporal_safety: Computed from current transaction features only
severity_index.observability: Makes severe scenarios observable by aggregating severity-weighted indicators
